h7_ruling.h7c_refutation: An assertion fingerprint excludes target and document context, which is category-determining, and the repository’s own accepted evidence contains a counterexample: TRANCHE_3M_DIVERGENT_COLLISION_ID collides across an already accepted B/C split (B in test_custom_domain.py, C twice in the 3m source file). "Colliding fingerprints never disagree on category" is therefore a per-shard accepted-time measurement, not a repository invariant. No fingerprint/category collision invariant is added to the current validator.
